title: Lollogiaiello's dungeons
description: The ultimate modpack for adventurers. Explore vast biomes, mine endless ores, and conquer epic bosses. Choose your path as a mage or knight and save the world.
body:
Your journey starts now chose the path of a mage, a knight or whoever you want to be and explore this beautifull world with 3+ different biomes mods.

this modpack contains over 300 ores and every ore as a different armor set and you can even fuse ores to make your own armor and play with your own creations.

Defeat more than 10+ bosses in this modpack, you can go against samurais or against a giant blaze that drops a unique sword, to get throght the portal you will need 12 eyes this eyes arent like the normal eyes becouse they are protected by vanilla based bosses so you will need to explore this beutifull world to.

With a new rework of the end and the nether and 300+ different biomes this modpack becomes one of the best exploration and rpg modpacks ever, so what are you waiting for, start exploring this beutifull world however you like. You canplay wwith friends too!
